response.summary: The record documents RA on methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly with a plan for VATS under general anesthesia, but it never addresses perioperative handling of methotrexate, RA-related lung disease, or anesthesia/airway concerns. Whether RA or methotrexate matters for surgery is not answered here; the record only gives the relevant background.

where_to_look: Discuss perioperative methotrexate management with the patient's rheumatologist and the surgical/anesthesia team, and confirm the actual dose.
Review the full chest CT for interstitial changes, and review the PFTs when done, given RA and methotrexate.
Ask about cervical spine involvement and other RA-related anesthesia/airway concerns, and any other immunosuppressive drugs or steroids.
